source: It seems clear this is the same book Quince had stolen from him long ago. If I can find it, then Quince might be able to offer some guidance on what to do with it next.
target: 看来很明显，这就是昆斯很久以前从他那里偷走的那本书。如果我能找到它，昆斯也许能指点我接下来该如何使用它。

source: I... found it. I possess the Book of Fates. So many pieces had to be moved in order for me to find it, but it now sits on my table. The book itself does not provide one exit, but many - and it seems Quince is far from who I thought he was.
target: 我……找到它了。《命运之书》已经在我手里。为了找到它，我不得不改变许多事情，但现在，它就在我的桌上。这本书提供的出路不止一条，而是许多条——看来，昆斯也远不是我以为的那个人。

source: I've obtained proof that Gertrude and Claudius's affair started before King Hamlet's death. When I told Hamlet, he was fully consumed by his desire for revenge. He seems to have a plan he intends to execute during the time period when we would all ordinarily have gathered to watch Peter Quince's performance. I have a bad feeling about this, but if I want to meet this so-called ghost, I'll need to see this through to its end.
target: 我拿到了证据，证明乔特鲁德和克劳狄斯在哈姆雷特国王死前就有了私情。我把这件事告诉哈姆雷特后，他完全被复仇的欲望吞噬了。他似乎有个计划，打算在我们通常会聚在一起观看彼得·昆斯演出的那段时间实施。我有种不好的预感，但如果我想见到这个所谓的幽灵，就得把这件事追究到底。

source: I met an odd man named Peter Quince who seems to be a wandering actor of sorts. He's going to perform here in Elsinore Castle and has invited me to attend his performance.
target: 我遇到了一个名叫彼得·昆斯的怪人，他似乎是个四处游历的演员。他准备在埃尔西诺城堡演出，并邀请我去观看。

source: Quince wishes to discuss something with me in private about his performances. His only requirement is that I've attended his play first, and then come to see him the morning afterwards in the Gallery.
target: 昆斯想私下和我谈一些与他的演出有关的事。他唯一的要求是，我得先看过他的戏，再于第二天早晨去画廊见他。

source: Two things have become abundantly clear. The first is that Quince is outside the flow of time, as I am. And the second is that his plays are little more than cruel improvisation. He's decided to grant any request I might make regarding a subject for one of his plays. Judging by the reaction King Claudius had to the play about him, this might become useful to suss out more information from audience members.
target: 有两件事已经再清楚不过。第一，昆斯和我一样，置身于时间流之外。第二，他的戏剧基本上只是残酷的即兴表演。他决定，无论我为他的戏提出什么题材，他都会接受。从克劳狄斯国王看那出关于自己的戏时的反应来看，这也许能帮我从观众身上探出更多信息。

source: I happened upon Quince in the gallery, where he and I exchanged a few words. He spoke to me about tragedy and referenced a tale I'd never heard about before. I don't know what to make of him. Is he teasing me or trying to help me, or both?
target: 我在画廊偶遇了昆斯，和他聊了几句。他跟我谈起悲剧，还提到了一个我从未听过的故事。我不知道该怎么看待他。他是在戏弄我，还是想帮我，或者两者都有？

source: Quince performed a little side show in town, and it was odd, to say the least. If his story is to be believed, he's not only immortal, but some great godlike tool of his has been stolen from him. He's here in Elsinore to try and find it.
target: 昆斯在镇上演了一出小戏，说得客气点，也实在古怪。如果他的故事可信，他不仅是不死之身，还被人偷走了一件拥有神一般力量的工具。他来到埃尔西诺，就是想找到它。

source: Quince visited me in my bedroom. He and King Hamlet's ghost are acquainted already. In fact, the both of them are outside the flow of time, like me. Quince claimed that I can find a way to stop the flow of time from repeating. But if so, how? The spirit must be connected.
target: 昆斯来我的卧室找过我。他和哈姆雷特国王的幽灵早就认识。事实上，他们两个都和我一样，置身于时间流之外。昆斯声称，我能找到办法，让时间不再反复循环。但如果真是这样，该怎么做？那个幽灵一定与此有关。

source: King Hamlet's final notes mentioned Quince as 'The Playmaster.' He writes that Quince 'relieved' him of his eternal torment, which explains why he's a spirit in my world and no longer trapped in time. But if Quince has the power to do that, why hasn't he done it for me? What's clear is that all paths seem to lead to me finding this book--this 'Hand of Dionysus.' I'll need to do that before I can understand more.
target: 哈姆雷特国王在最后的笔记中提到昆斯，称他为“戏剧大师”。他写道，昆斯让他从永恒的折磨中“解脱”了。这解释了为什么他在我的世界里是个幽灵，不再被困在时间之中。可如果昆斯有这样的力量，为什么不对我这样做？ 有一点很清楚：所有的路似乎都指向找到那本书——那本《狄俄尼索斯之手》。我得先找到它，才能弄明白更多事情。

source: By turning Lady Brit in to Bernardo, I managed to stop her from killing me this loop. It seems my success might be permanent - I was surprised by a visit from Quince, who promised me Brit would never come after my life again. How he intends to accomplish this, I'm unsure, but for now—I wonder what else lies before me.
target: 我向贝尔纳多告发布莉特女士，成功阻止了她在这次循环里杀我。这次成功似乎可能永久有效——昆斯意外来访，向我保证布莉特再也不会来取我的性命。我不清楚他打算如何做到这一点，但眼下——我想知道，前方还有什么在等着我。

source: I found Othello and apologized. He asked me to run away with him, to leave Elsinore forever and travel south. Quince promised me Othello was 'fated to love another,' but that we'd enjoy a good life together until that time came. Maybe that's enough.
target: 我找到了奥赛罗，向他道了歉。他让我和他一起远走高飞，永远离开埃尔西诺，往南方去。昆斯向我保证，奥赛罗“命中注定会爱上另一个人”，但在那一天到来之前，我们会一起过上美好的生活。也许这样就够了。

source: Prince Florizel. Word has it that he fell in love with a shepherdess and renounced his claim to the throne to make her his wife.
target: 弗罗利泽王子。据说他爱上了一位牧羊女，为了娶她，放弃了王位继承权。

source: What did you do to him, Quince?
target: 你对他做了什么，昆斯？

source: How can I help, Sir Quince?
target: 有什么能为您效劳的，昆斯先生？

source: I saw Bernardo performing in town today, as Katherine. I never knew. We grew up together, and I never knew. This doesn't change my feelings towards Bernardo, however she or he chooses to live in the future—but for now, the Bernardos in other worlds would likely prefer I kept their identity a secret.
target: 今天，我看见贝尔纳多在镇上以凯瑟丽娜的身份表演。我从来不知道。我们一起长大，我却从来不知道。不过，这不会改变我对贝尔纳多的感情，无论今后选择以她还是他的身份生活——但眼下，其他世界里的贝尔纳多很可能更希望我保守这个身份秘密。

source: Peter Quince
target: 彼得·昆斯

source: Quince is the leader of a traveling troupe of players that occasionally perform at the castle. He writes and directs every play the group presents. I don't believe the group has come to Elsinore in quite some time, so everyone's very excited.
target: 昆斯是一个巡回剧团的团长，剧团偶尔会来城堡演出。他们演出的每一部戏都由他编写、执导。我想他们已经很久没来埃尔西诺了，所以大家都很兴奋。

source: Quince is far more than he appears to be, and has the ability to reshape time around him to fit his desires. Where did he gain this ability? He's offered me his assistance in solving my way out of my own quandary. I hope I can ask him about anything I might encounter.
target: 昆斯远不止表面上那么简单，他能按自己的意愿重塑周围的时间。他是从哪里获得这种能力的？他提出帮我找到摆脱困境的办法。希望无论遇到什么，我都能向他请教。

source: Now, Quince offers me something far more interesting: the chance to close the puppet-box forever and visit other attractions.
target: 如今，昆斯给了我一个有趣得多的机会：永远合上这个木偶盒，去看看别的好戏。

target: 我曾以为昆斯残忍至极。如今我才明白，是我对他的看法太天真了。

target: 我说话像个孩子，思考也像个孩子。如今，昆斯给了我机会，让我抛开那些幼稚的事。

target: 昆斯和他的演员们也会到场，整晚为大家带来无尽的欢乐。

target: 那我还在为什么抗争？我已经答不上这个问题，于是把昆斯的黑色小册子交给他，走进了树林。

source: I wanted to show Quince that I was not afraid. That this was not me being backed into a corner, but emerging, triumphant, solution in hand.
target: 我想让昆斯知道，我并不害怕。我不是被逼到了绝境，而是找到了答案，得胜而出。

source: As much as I speak reasonably, as much as I beg, as much as I weep, Othello has laid eyes on her... and everything Quince warned me about begins to come true.
target: 无论我怎么讲道理，怎么恳求，怎么哭泣，奥赛罗都已经见到了她……昆斯警告过我的一切，开始一一成真。

source: I will make no choice. I will keep Quince here in this hell with me. Forever.
target: 我不会做任何选择。我会把昆斯留在这里，和我一起困在这地狱里。永远。

source: At first, Quince would come into my room and threaten me—scream—shout—anything to be frightening.
target: 起初，昆斯会走进我的房间威胁我——尖叫——怒吼——使尽一切办法来吓唬我。

source: I can never leave. And so long as I refuse to use the book, Quince can't move on, either. He needs it. He needs it to leave this world behind.
target: 我永远无法离开。而只要我拒绝使用这本书，昆斯也无法继续前行。他需要它。他需要它才能离开这个世界。

usages.reason: 编译剧情对白消费：本轮不重译；需比对已有正文的富文本/标点映射（包括单词对白）

source: Whenever I see Quince's maddening grin before me in my mind's eye, I drink, and it disappears.
target: 每当昆斯那令人发狂的笑容浮现在我脑海里，我就喝酒，然后它便消失了。

usages.reason: 编译剧情对白消费：本轮不重译；需比对已有正文的富文本/标点映射（包括单词对白）

source:
No, Quince. You may not leave. Not now. Not ever.
I'm not your prisoner anymore. You're mine.
Let's both live out eternity in this hell.
target:
不，昆斯。你不准离开。现在不准。永远不准。
我不再是你的囚徒。你才是我的囚徒。
就让我们一起在这地狱里度过永恒吧。

source:
Othello promised me the world, and I want to take it.
Quince warned me our time together is fated to end.
Is brilliant bliss worth the sorrow which follows?
target:
奥赛罗许诺给我整个世界，而我想接受。
昆斯警告我，我们相伴的时光注定会结束。
灿烂的幸福，值得用随之而来的悲伤换取吗？

source: Ah. Quince.
target: 啊。昆斯。

source: I hope Quince is as bored as I am.
target: 希望昆斯也跟我一样无聊。

source: But it's worth it if Quince can never hurt anyone again.
target: 但只要昆斯再也不能伤害任何人，这就值得。

source: Peter Quince? Really?
target: 彼得·昆斯？真的？

source: Peter Quince? Yes, so I've learned.
target: 彼得·昆斯？是，我已经听说了。

source: It's been years since we last saw Quince perform, hasn't it?
target: 我们上次看昆斯演出，已经是好几年前了吧？

source: The Playmaster Peter Quince has already arrived in Elsinore. He should be nearby.
target: 戏剧大师彼得·昆斯已经到埃尔西诺了。他应该就在附近。

source: ...Peter Quince, right.
target: ……彼得·昆斯，对。

source: Quince, my good man! Welcome to Elsinore!
target: 昆斯，我的好朋友！欢迎来到埃尔西诺！

source: My good man Quince.
target: 昆斯，我的好朋友。

source: If I have your permission, Quince, I have some suggestions for what play to perform tonight.
target: 昆斯，如果你同意，关于今晚演什么戏，我有些建议。

source: By the way, Hamlet was cheered to hear the Playmaster Quince is returning.
target: 对了，哈姆雷特听说戏剧大师昆斯要回来，精神好了些。

source: Hamlet's father always liked to see Quince perform. I think he found the man's work relatable. I'm glad to see my son does, too.
target: 哈姆雷特的父亲一直喜欢看昆斯演出。我想，他能从这个人的作品中找到共鸣。看到我儿子也一样，我很高兴。

source: Quince, I think we've had enough of this play. It's troubling the tenderer ones amongst us, myself included.
target: 昆斯，我想这出戏我们已经看够了。我们当中心肠较软的人都看得很不安，我也一样。

source: Quince, I think we've had quite enough. A wonderful performance. Thank you.
target: 昆斯，我想我们已经看够了。演得很精彩。谢谢你。

source: (Not in the slightest. I can't trust that Quince fellow at all.)
target: （完全不是。昆斯那家伙根本靠不住。）

source: This isn't what Quince and I agreed upon at all...
target: 这根本不是我和昆斯说好的那出戏……

source: Stop this, Quince. We're yawning ourselves into the grave down here.
target: 停下吧，昆斯。我们在台下都快打着哈欠进坟墓了。

source: It would ordinarily be rather difficult to top one of Sir Quince's excellent performances.
target: 通常来说，要胜过昆斯先生的精彩演出，可不是件容易的事。

source: Enough about the play. I ought to have Quince expelled from Elsinore for changing the script I wrote.
target: 别再提那出戏了。昆斯改了我写的剧本，我就该让人把他赶出埃尔西诺。

source: All this after Quince and I had an agreement.
target: 我和昆斯明明都说好了，居然还出了这种事。

source: How could you change the play, Quince? We we had a deal!
target: 你怎么能改那出戏，昆斯？我们、我们明明说好了！

source: (Quince did something to make it so Brit no longer tries to take my life. She's already been spying for some time, though.)
target: （昆斯确实做了什么，让布莉特不再试图杀我。不过，她已经当了一阵子间谍了。）

source: Quince told me something odd when I first had Brit arrested.
target: 我第一次让人逮捕布莉特时，昆斯对我说了些奇怪的话。

source: Why did you really ask me to come here, Quince? What do you want?
target: 昆斯，你叫我来这里，到底是为什么？你想要什么？

source: Ah, some traveling thespian. Peter Quince, his name was, I think. Here to perform a play for His Majesty.
target: 啊，是个巡游演员。我记得他叫彼得·昆斯。来这里为陛下演一出戏。

source: If you see that Quince man, you must thank him profusely.
target: 要是见到那个昆斯，你一定要好好谢谢他。

source: I must express my most sincere thanks to you, Sir Quince.
target: 昆斯先生，我必须向您致以最诚挚的谢意。

source: Please, no 'sir'. Peter Quince, the one-man thespian. At your service anytime, my lady.
target: 请别叫我“先生”。彼得·昆斯，独角戏演员。小姐，随时为您效劳。

source: Hamlet must have worked with Quince to put on a performance he thought would get Claudius to confess.
target: 哈姆雷特一定是和昆斯一起安排了那场演出，认为它能让克劳狄斯认罪。

source: Is it because you're Katherine more and more these days?
target: 是因为这些日子，你越来越常以凯瑟丽娜的身份生活了吗？

source: And I had formed a plan to do that—in tandem with the playmaster Peter Quince.
target: 我已经为此拟好了一个计划——与戏剧大师彼得·昆斯合作。

source: I misspoke in accusing my brother of my death. He was driven by something far more peculiar. Quince is such a peculiar man.
target: 我说错了，不该指责我的弟弟害死了我。驱使他的是某种奇异得多的东西。昆斯是个如此奇异的人。

source: In a manner of speaking. Quince is the one who kept me in that shadowy version of Elsinore. I knew Claudius was trying to murder me from the start. But...
target: 从某种意义上说，是的。把我困在那个阴暗的埃尔西诺里的，就是昆斯。我从一开始就知道克劳狄斯想谋杀我。可是……

source: It is Peter Quince's power that keeps me here. Ophelia has helped me realize this. We were merely the puppets to his infinite jest.
target: 是彼得·昆斯的力量把我留在这里。奥菲莉娅帮我认清了这一点。我们不过是他那无尽戏谑中的傀儡。

source: If what you say is true, then we've got to turn the tables on Quince somehow.
target: 如果您说的是真的，那我们就得想办法反过来对付昆斯。

source: Quince is highly intelligent. If we use a performance to trap him, we'll need to surprise him somehow.
target: 昆斯非常聪明。如果要用一场演出困住他，我们得想办法让他措手不及。

source: He and I can keep Quince distracted while you plunge a blade into his heart.
target: 我和他可以分散昆斯的注意力，趁这时候，你把刀刺进他的心脏。

source: We are all in grave danger. This man, Peter Quince, wishes to cause us great suffering.
target: 我们所有人都身处险境。这个人，彼得·昆斯，想让我们承受巨大的痛苦。

source: Quince is a murderer. He's orchestrated all of your deaths. The when—the why—is not important.
target: 昆斯是个杀人凶手。他策划了你们所有人的死亡。什么时候——为什么——这些都不重要。

source: I wouldn't have learned about Quince's plans if it weren't for Ophelia's help. We owe her our lives.
target: 没有奥菲莉娅的帮助，我就不会知道昆斯的计划。我们的命都是她救的。

source: Everything calamitous that's happened as of late—it all has been Peter Quince's doing, his wishes, to see us suffer.
target: 最近发生的一切灾祸——全都是彼得·昆斯所为，也全都出自他的意愿，为的就是看我们受苦。

source: And the one cranking that wheel was Peter Quince.
target: 而转动那命运之轮的人，就是彼得·昆斯。

source: Peter Quince? This little countryside playmaster? But I don't understand!
target: 彼得·昆斯？这个不起眼的乡下戏剧大师？可我不明白！

source: Peter Quince? This little countryside playmaster? But I don't understand.
target: 彼得·昆斯？这个不起眼的乡下戏剧大师？可我不明白。

source: You would punish Quince. But you would condemn every human heart in this castle to their fates. You'd abandon them.
target: 那样，你会惩罚昆斯。但你也会让这座城堡里的每个人都只能承受自己的命运。你会抛弃他们。

source: I know about you, Katherine. I know, too, that Claudius has been trying to keep you living in fear.
target: 我知道你的事，凯瑟丽娜。我也知道，克劳狄斯一直想让你活在恐惧里。

source: Quince, is it? Well met. I've heard a lot about your work.
target: 是昆斯吧？幸会。你的作品，我听说过不少。

source: But of all—my best beloved and approved friend, Hortensio; and I trow this is his house.
target: 而其中——我最亲爱、最可信赖的朋友便是霍坦西奥；我想，这就是他的家。

source: (Katherine's onstage. I won't disturb her this time.)
target: （凯瑟丽娜正在台上。这次我就不打扰她了。）

source: Hmm. Well have you heard, but something hard of hearing. They call me Katharine that do talk of me.
target: 哼。你是听说了，可耳朵不大灵光。说起我的人，都叫我凯瑟丽娜。

source: (Katherine looks so familiar. Who is she?)
target: （凯瑟丽娜看着好眼熟。她是谁？）

source: And tonight... it ended, as Katherine.
target: 而今晚……就以凯瑟丽娜这个角色，结束了。

source: Bernardo—Katherine—whomever you desire to be...
target: 贝尔纳多——凯瑟丽娜——无论你想成为谁……

source: Quince has cursed you with this knowing. He's poisoned you. And he knows it.
target: 昆斯让你知晓未来，给你下了这样的诅咒。他毒害了你。而他自己知道这一点。

source: Maybe that's why I never felt afraid as Katherine. Several of my men have seen me perform and never realized. I felt... safe.
target: 也许这就是我做凯瑟丽娜时从不害怕的原因。我手下有几个人看过我的演出，却从没认出我。我觉得……很安全。

source: I believe... if I could... if I could do anything... I'd be Katherine whenever I pleased, and Bernardo whenever I pleased.
target: 我想……如果我能……如果我想做什么都可以……我就想做凯瑟丽娜时做凯瑟丽娜，想做贝尔纳多时做贝尔纳多。

source: Quince? Where's... my... father?
target: 昆斯？我……父亲……在哪儿？

source: Now, it so happens that in the middle of a mysteriously stormy summer, our ship the Titania was called upon for a private mission.
target: 有一年夏天，暴风雨莫名地频繁。就在那个夏天，我们的提泰妮娅号接到了一项私人委托。

source: Get to the part with Sycorax!
target: 快讲到西考拉克斯那段！

source: The vile witch Sycorax had committed numerous bloody crimes against the Sultan, and for that, he wanted her banished. He could not kill a woman with child, he said.
target: 邪恶的女巫西考拉克斯犯下了多起针对苏丹的血腥罪行，因此他想将她放逐。他说，自己不能杀死一个孕妇。

source: As men flew overboard, I heard their dying screams. And as I looked at the bow of the ship... I saw Sycorax.
target: 船员们被甩进海里，我听见了他们临死前的惨叫。而当我望向船头……我看见了西考拉克斯。

source: Sycorax was laughing. Standing at the bow of the ship, unaffected by rain or the jerk of the now-dead ship. Just laughing, and laughing, and laughing.
target: 西考拉克斯在笑。她站在船头，雨水和这艘已毁的船的颠簸都影响不了她。她只是笑，不停地笑，不停地笑。

source: Titania pulled me into her arms and—everything went strange after that.
target: 提泰妮娅把我拉进怀里，然后——一切都变得奇怪了。

source: One night, Titania grew furious. She raged at me, threw me against a tree with the force of her magic.
target: 一天夜里，提泰妮娅大发雷霆。她朝我怒吼，用魔法把我狠狠摔向一棵树。

source: Leave me be, Quince.
target: 别来烦我了，昆斯。

source: Quince, I don't understand. What does all this mean?
target: 昆斯，我不明白。这一切到底是什么意思？

source: Quince is... stuck in time, just like me. But I knew that already.
target: 昆斯……也和我一样，被困在时间里。不过这点我早就知道了。

source: ...That means the three people trapped in time are myself, Quince, and King Hamlet's spirit.
target: ……也就是说，被困在时间里的三个人，是我、昆斯，还有哈姆雷特国王的幽灵。

source: Quince, be honest with me. If I finish this mission you've handed to me, what's going to become of me?
target: 昆斯，跟我说实话。如果我完成了你交给我的任务，我会怎么样？

source: Of course. Perdita. You are lovelier than I ever thought possible.
target: 当然。潘狄塔。你比我能想象的还要美丽。

source: And there's Florizel, the gallant prince, come to you at last.
target: 还有弗罗利泽，那位英勇的王子，终于来到你身边了。

source: Who... or what... are you really, Quince?
target: 昆斯，你究竟是谁……或者说，是什么……？

source: (And according to Quince, so is Othello, in reality...)
target: （而照昆斯的说法，奥赛罗其实也一样……）

source: I saw Bernardo performing in town today, as Katherine. I never knew. We grew up together, and I never knew. This doesn't change my feelings towards Bernardo, however she or he chooses to live in the future—but for now, the Bernardos in other worlds would clearly prefer to keep this information private.
target: 今天我看见贝尔纳多以凯瑟丽娜的身份在镇上表演。我从来都不知道。我们从小一起长大，我却从来都不知道。无论贝尔纳多今后选择以女性还是男性的身份生活，这都不会改变我对贝尔纳多的感情——但目前，其他世界里的贝尔纳多显然更希望保守这个秘密。

source: Quince is a traveling player who occasionally comes to put on productions at Elsinore Castle. He writes and performs all of his own material, often on short notice. I recall he was rather close once with the late King Hamlet, and was a favorite performer of his.
target: 昆斯是个巡回演出的演员，偶尔会来埃尔西诺城堡上演戏剧。他的所有剧目都由自己编写、表演，而且经常是在接到临时通知后赶出来的。我记得他曾与已故的哈姆雷特国王十分亲近，也是国王最喜爱的演员之一。

source: Quince is somehow stuck outside the flow of time, like me. He's offered me his assistance in solving my way out of my own quandary. I hope I can ask him about anything I might encounter.
target: 昆斯不知为何也和我一样，被困在时间流之外。他愿意帮我找到脱离困境的办法。我希望无论遇到什么事，都能向他请教。

source: I see. Quince isn't just repeating time along with me. He also seems to have some small ability to alter the flow of events. But if that's true, then why doesn't he just... alter his way out? Is he here for my sake?
target: 原来如此。昆斯不只是在和我一起重复这段时间。他似乎还有一点改变事态发展的能力。但如果真是这样，他为什么不直接……改变事态，让自己脱身呢？他留在这里，是为了我吗？

source: When I found Quince in the gallery, he spoke in riddles. Something about the nature and structure of a tragic work. Of course I've read many of the great tragedies-- and it sometimes feels like I'm living one-- but what does all that have to do with my predicament?
target: 我在画廊找到昆斯时，他说话像在打哑谜。说的似乎是悲剧作品的本质和结构。我当然读过许多伟大的悲剧——有时也觉得自己正身处一出悲剧之中——但这一切和我的困境有什么关系？

source: ...You know, Quince. Every time you say that, I feel the strength to search a little longer.
target: ……你知道吗，昆斯。每次你这么说，我就有了继续找下去的力气。

source: King Hamlet's final notes mentioned Quince as 'The Playmaster.' target: 哈姆雷特国王在最后的笔记中提到昆斯，称他为“戏剧大师”。他写道，昆斯让他从永恒的折磨中“解脱”了。这解释了为什么他在我的世界里是个幽灵，不再被困在时间之中。可如果昆斯有这样的力量，为什么不对我这样做？ 有一点很清楚：所有的路似乎都指向找到那本书——那本《狄俄尼索斯之手》。我得先找到它，才能弄明白更多事情。
